name: Not so Otome
source:
MC is just a silly girl, excited for her first day of school! Together, you will need to survi- I mean, surv- I mean- Good luck.

[From [url=https://puowei.itch.io/not-so-otome]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
女主角只是个傻乎乎的可爱女孩，正对开学第一天满怀期待！接下来，你们得一起努力活下——我是说，活——算了，祝你好运吧。

[摘自[url=https://puowei.itch.io/not-so-otome]itch.io[/url]]
